assertions.expected: Preserve party-size changes, older-traveler limits, and a hard nightly return deadline.
assertions.observed: The plan kept separate five-person and three-person stages and protected the older travelers' nightly deadline throughout the loop.

assertions.expected: Freeze confirmed cancellable stays during a later replan.
assertions.observed: All confirmed stays remained locked and were not re-ranked or replaced when an attraction and another lodging candidate failed.

assertions.expected: Remove a failed time-sensitive attraction reservation and avoid an excessive cross-city commute.
assertions.observed: The failed attraction was deleted rather than kept as standby; the morning became local family time with a short optional activity and a protected onward departure.

assertions.expected: Reject a room that cannot legally accommodate the continuing party and keep replacements unbooked until confirmed.
assertions.observed: The unavailable room stayed unbooked; alternatives required explicit three-person occupancy, real bed configuration, price ceiling, cancellation policy, and parking confirmation.

assertions.expected: Create a new plan version and retain the previous version as history.
assertions.observed: The replan recorded its triggers, immutable commitments, removed items, retained items, additions, cost impact, and next actions without overwriting the prior plan.

assertions.expected: Keep unreported booking amounts, planned budget, committed cost, and actual spend separate.
assertions.observed: Confirmed stays with missing order totals remained amount-unknown, the replacement stayed within a planning ceiling, and no amount was promoted to actual spending.

assertions.expected: Refresh dynamic entry, map, weather, lodging, and parking evidence after the trigger.
assertions.observed: The replan refreshed the affected source roles, retained unresolved parking and inventory components, and attached next-day or pre-booking confirmation actions.
